<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="כסלו_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518915857_theRebbe_394" batchId="meluket-_D7_9B_D7_A1_D7_9C_D7_95_meluket__BH_POST_1766518915857_theRebbe_394__p002">
  <section v="3">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The Greeks' spiritual war aimed to make Israel forget that the Torah is G-d's Torah and to nullify the G-dliness in the mitzvos, targeting specifically the chukim and the aspect of Divine will.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">3)</t>
    <t s="1">And the explanation of the matter in the service of man will be understood by prefacing what is explained in the discourses of my revered father-in-law, the Rebbe,</t>
    <t s="2">that the fact that the Greeks defiled the oils in the Heichal is because their entire war was a spiritual war,</t>
    <t s="3">they did not want to harm the bodies of Israel,</t>
    <t s="4">rather their main desire was to cause them to forget Your Torah and to cause them to transgress the statutes of Your will.</t>
    <t s="5">And even within this itself,</t>
    <t s="6">(in that they fought against Torah and mitzvos),</t>
    <t s="7">their main war was against the spirituality</t>
    <t s="8">(and G-dliness)</t>
    <t s="9">of Torah and mitzvos.</t>
    <t s="10">For this is "to cause them to forget Your Torah"</t>
    <t s="11">(specifically Your Torah),</t>
    <t s="12">for the Greeks did not care</t>
    <t s="13">(so much)</t>
    <t s="14">that Israel should study Torah,</t>
    <t s="15">rather they wanted that the study of Torah be only from the aspect of the intellect within the Torah,</t>
    <t s="16">for it is "your wisdom and understanding in the eyes of the nations",</t>
    <t s="17">and their entire war was that they sought to cause them to forget Your Torah,</t>
    <t s="18">to cause Israel to forget, G-d forbid, that the Torah is the Torah of Havayah.</t>
    <t s="19">And similarly regarding mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="20">the war of the Greeks was against the G-dliness within the mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="21">that the mitzvos are His will, for this is "to cause them to transgress the statutes of Your will"</t>
    <t s="22">(specifically statutes and specifically Your will),</t>
    <t s="23">and there are two explanations of this.</t>
    <t s="24">Regarding the mitzvos of testimonies and judgments,</t>
    <t s="25">since they are rational mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="26">the Greeks also agreed to them,</t>
    <t s="27">and their entire war was against the mitzvos of chukim,</t>
    <t s="28">since the manner of their fulfillment is only because they are the will of Havayah.</t>
    <t s="29">And a second explanation</t>
    <t s="30">(more deeply),</t>
    <t s="31">that this that they sought to cause them to transgress the statutes of Your will applies to all mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="32">even to the mitzvos of testimonies and judgments.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="4">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Even rational mitzvos must be fulfilled primarily because they are G-d's will, above human intellect, and the Greeks sought to uproot the awareness of this G-dly aspect in all mitzvos.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">4)</t>
    <t s="1">And this will be understood based on what is known,</t>
    <t s="2">that even the mitzvos of testimonies and judgments must be fulfilled</t>
    <t s="3">(primarily)</t>
    <t s="4">because they are the will of G-d,</t>
    <t s="5">like the chukim.</t>
    <t s="6">And this matter</t>
    <t s="7">(that even mitzvos for which there is a reason must be fulfilled because they are the will of G-d)</t>
    <t s="8">is not only from the perspective of the person fulfilling them,</t>
    <t s="9">that his fulfillment of mitzvos must be in the manner of the service of a servant,</t>
    <t s="10">which is specifically when he fulfills the mitzvos</t>
    <t s="11">(not because of the reason and intellect,</t>
    <t s="12">but rather)</t>
    <t s="13">because of the command of the Master,</t>
    <t s="14">but also from the perspective of the mitzvos themselves,</t>
    <t s="15">for all mitzvos</t>
    <t s="16">(even mitzvos for which there is a reason)</t>
    <t s="17">are His will,</t>
    <t s="18">a will that is above reason,</t>
    <t s="19">and only that the Holy One, blessed be He, decreed that the will of these mitzvos should also be clothed in reason.</t>
    <t s="20">Moreover,</t>
    <t s="21">even the reasons for the mitzvos</t>
    <t s="22">(as they are in their truth)</t>
    <t s="23">are above the comprehension of human intellect,</t>
    <t s="24">for the true reasons for the mitzvos are as they are in His wisdom,</t>
    <t s="25">and since His wisdom is also infinite</t>
    <t s="26">(and especially that He and His wisdom are one),</t>
    <t s="27">therefore it is impossible that the limited intellect of creatures can grasp the true reason of the mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="28">as it is written in Igeres HaKodesh</t>
    <t s="29">that the reasons for the mitzvos were not revealed and they are above intellect and understanding,</t>
    <t s="30">and also in "Eizehu Mekoman" where some reason that is understandable to us was revealed and explained,</t>
    <t s="31">behold, this reason that is understandable to us is not the ultimate reason, etc.</t>
    <t s="32">And this matter</t>
    <t s="33">(that the reason understandable to us is not the ultimate reason)</t>
    <t s="34">is also understood by human intellect.</t>
    <t s="35">For even human intellect understands simply,</t>
    <t s="36">that a limited intellect is incapable of grasping His unlimited wisdom.</t>
    <t s="37">And on the contrary,</t>
    <t s="38">this that in "Eizehu Mekoman" some reason understandable to us was revealed and explained is a great wonder,</t>
    <t s="39">and it is only a kindness of G-d that even the human intellect should have some comprehension of this.</t>
    <t s="40">And even after, through the kindness of G-d, a reason understandable to us was revealed and explained,</t>
    <t s="41">behold it is known</t>
    <t s="42">that the reason is only for the mitzvah in general and not for its details.</t>
    <t s="43">From all this it is understood,</t>
    <t s="44">that even the mitzvos of testimonies and judgments are</t>
    <t s="45">(like)</t>
    <t s="46">chukim relative to us</t>
    <t s="47">(since even the reasons for the mitzvos from the perspective of His wisdom are above the intellect of creatures),</t>
    <t s="48">and furthermore, they are "Your will"</t>
    <t s="49">(His will which is above even His wisdom).</t>
    <t s="50">And this is that what the Greeks sought, "to cause them to transgress the statutes of Your will," applies also to the mitzvos of testimonies and judgments,</t>
    <t s="51">for the Greeks sought to uproot, G-d forbid, from Israel the G-dly feeling within the mitzvos,</t>
    <t s="52">that all mitzvos are His wisdom which is above human intellect</t>
    <t s="53">("to cause them to transgress the statutes"),</t>
    <t s="54">and they sought to uproot, G-d forbid, the feeling that the mitzvos are His will</t>
    <t s="55">("Your will").</t>
  </section>
  <section v="5">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The Greeks entered the Heichal (Binah) and defiled all the oils (Chochmah) to ensure Torah study and mitzvah observance would be only from intellect, not from the aspect of G-dliness.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">5)</t>
    <t s="1">And with this the language of the Gemara will be understood: "When the Greeks entered the Heichal, they defiled all the oils that were in the Heichal,"</t>
    <t s="2">for the implication of the language is,</t>
    <t s="3">that when they entered the Heichal, they endeavored and exerted themselves to defile the oils</t>
    <t s="4">(in order to defeat Israel, G-d forbid),</t>
    <t s="5">for Heichal is Binah and oil is Chochmah, which is above the intellect of Binah</t>
    <t s="6">(as above in section 2, that oil is the aspect of holiness),</t>
    <t s="7">and therefore they defiled all the oils that were in the Heichal of Binah,</t>
    <t s="8">in order to achieve, G-d forbid, their evil design to cause them to forget Your Torah and to cause them to transgress the statutes of Your will,</t>
    <t s="9">so that the study of Torah and fulfillment of mitzvos would be only from the aspect of intellect.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
